name: Toaru Majutsu to Kagaku no Ensemble
original_name: とある魔術と科学の群奏活劇（アンサンブル）
source:
The game scenario is written by Kamachi, and is split in four stories: "Magic (Surface)", "Magic (Hidden)", "Science (Surface)", and "Science (Hidden)", with each story having a different protagonist.

In the "Magic (Surface)" story, the Gate of the Gods Descended from Heaven, a Magic Cabal, whose existence is wrapped in a veil of mystery. This story is the one that is featured in Toaru Majutsu no Index: Road to Endymion light novel. In the "Magic (Hidden)" story, the Venus Probe Contest, is a contest in which rockets are launched throughout the world to probe Venus. An event related to that project called the "Venus Probe Project Race" is being held on the Academy City SNS Rondo Net. Here, an incident begins when Kamijou Touma applies for the race. Finally, in the "Science (Hidden)" story, the Academy City SNS Rondo Net is a type of SNS that has grown popular among Academy City students, where registered users can not only communicate amongst each other, but can also acquire things like coupons and for buying things. The number of users of the service has grown explosively. Saten Ruiko has an eye for the current fads, so she tries out the service.

[from [url=http://toarumajutsunoindex.wikia.com/wiki/Toaru_Majutsu_to_Kagaku_no_Ensemble]Toaru Majutsu no Index Wiki[/url]]
translation:
游戏剧本由Kamachi编写，分为四个故事：“魔法（表面）”、“魔法（隐藏）”、“科学（表面）”和“科学（隐藏）”，每个故事都有不同的主角。

在《魔法（地表）》故事中，天降神门，一个魔法阴谋集团，其存在被蒙上了一层神秘的面纱。这个故事是轻小说《魔法索引：安底弥翁之路》中的故事。在《魔法（隐藏）》故事中，金星探测大赛，是一场向世界各地发射火箭探测金星的竞赛。与该计划相关的活动名为“维纳斯探测器计划竞赛”，正在学园都市SNS Rondo Net上举办。上条当麻报名参加比赛时，事件开始了。最后，在《科学（隐藏）》故事中，学园都市SNS Rondo Net是一种在学园都市学生中流行的SNS，注册用户不仅可以互相交流，还可以获取优惠券和购买东西等东西。该服务的用户数量呈爆炸式增长。佐天泪子（Saten Ruiko）对当前的时尚有敏锐的洞察力，因此她尝试了这项服务。

[来自[url=http://toarumajutsunoindex.wikia.com/wiki/Toaru_Majutsu_to_Kagaku_no_Ensemble]魔法索引Wiki[/url]]
